info.title: Daily Health and Food
info.description: Reads every Daily Overview data area and manages confirmed food, favorites, and meal plans. Uses Danish DTU Frida v5.5 for estimates and Sites as Dan's nutrition source of truth.

get.summary: Get the complete current Daily Overview
get.description: Use for current questions spanning priorities, email attention, calendar, habits, countdowns, source freshness, health, workouts, and nutrition. For calories left today, read health.today.calorieGlance.caloriesLeftKcal; it is full maintenance, not the 15% target.

200.description: Current combined Daily Overview data.

schema.description: Bounded read-only data returned from the same normalized Sites records used by Daily Overview.

get.summary: Get current health and workout facts
get.description: Use for current Apple Health sleep, steps, active calories, body measurements, workout goals, qualifying Gym and Run sessions, workout calories, sync freshness, and Sites nutrition. For calories left today, read today.calorieGlance.caloriesLeftKcal: full maintenance, not the 15% target.

200.description: Current Sites-backed health summary with full-maintenance calorie glance.

schema.description: Current normalized Apple Health and Sites nutrition data. For calories left today, read today.calorieGlance.caloriesLeftKcal.

get.summary: Get historical health and workout data
get.description: Use for dated questions about Apple Health sleep, workouts, activity, active or resting energy, body metrics, and workout calories. Query at most 93 days at a time and continue with another bounded window when needed.

200.description: Bounded historical health, sleep, workout, and metric rows.

schema.description: Bounded read-only data returned from the same normalized Sites records used by Daily Overview.

get.summary: Get one category of current attention items
get.description: Use for current reply-needed email, waiting-on-others email, priority tasks, all open tasks, or countdowns. The result is bounded and read-only.

200.description: Current bounded attention items.

schema.description: Bounded read-only data returned from the same normalized Sites records used by Daily Overview.

get.summary: Get calendar events for a date window
get.description: Use for questions about Google Calendar events or timed conflicts. Reads the current normalized Sites snapshot for a bounded window of at most 31 days.

200.description: Bounded calendar events and conflict facts.

schema.description: Bounded read-only data returned from the same normalized Sites records used by Daily Overview.

post.summary: Calculate food nutrients from DTU Frida
post.description: Resolve photo-derived ingredients against Danish DTU Frida v5.5 and calculate per-100 g nutrients. Read-only; never queues food. For an unmatched ingredient or uncertain amount, make a transparent general-knowledge estimate and ask Dan to confirm before logFood.

components.description: Photo-derived ingredients. Include the estimated edible grams and preparation method when visible or inferable; use null grams when the amount is unclear.

grams.description: Estimated edible weight in grams, or null when unknown.

preparationMethod.description: Visible or inferred preparation such as raw, boiled, fried, or grilled.

200.description: DTU Frida v5.5 matches and calculated per-ingredient and total nutrients; no food is queued.

post.description: Use after Dan asks to log food. For a photo or portion estimate, call lookupFood, show the DTU Frida v5.5 proposal, and wait; pass its values, not model totals. The response saves immediately in Daily Overview Sites and does not automatically export to Apple Health.

mealName.description: Short factual name for the meal.

components.description: Identifiable foods and the best available quantity for each.

preparationMethod.description: Optional visible or inferred preparation such as raw, boiled, fried, or grilled.

occurredAt.description: When the meal was eaten. Omit when Dan gives no time; the server will use the request time.

mealType.description: Optional. Do not ask only to classify the meal.

userConfirmed.description: True only when Dan directly asks to log, save, add, or record this meal.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable unique key for this meal so retries cannot create duplicates.

200.description: Meal saved permanently in Sites, or an idempotent retry returned the existing meal.

idempotencyKey.description: Exact retry, correction, deletion, and export key for this meal.

duplicate.description: True when this idempotency key already existed.

503.description: Nutrition storage or owner configuration is unavailable.

get.description: Use for every question about nutrition totals, averages, trends, comparisons, or patterns over any date range. Returns chart-ready series. When a chart helps, use /visualize with the returned series; otherwise give a concise table.

200.description: Sites-backed nutrition summary and chart-ready series.

post.description: Use only after Dan explicitly confirms a correction to one exact Sites meal. Resolve its idempotencyKey from history first. Any retained meal age can be corrected; there is no seven-day limit. Only supplied fields change.

200.description: Sites meal corrected.

post.description: Use only after Dan explicitly confirms deletion of one exact Sites meal. The canonical record is soft-deleted; an already exported Apple Health copy may remain.

200.description: Sites meal deleted or already absent.

post.summary: Queue a Sites nutrition period for Apple Health export
post.description: Use only when Dan explicitly asks to export a confirmed date range. Sites remains authoritative. The existing shared bearer token is reused by the Get Meals Shortcut.

200.description: Eligible meals queued idempotently for the Shortcut.

get.description: Use when Dan asks to remove a food log and the exact pending entry is unclear. Return only his pending entries. Match by meal name and time; if multiple entries plausibly match, ask which one before cancellation.

200.description: Current pending food entries available for exact identification.

idempotencyKey.description: Pass this exact value to cancelFood after Dan identifies this entry.

503.description: Food queue or owner configuration is unavailable.

post.summary: Cancel an exact pending food entry
post.description: Use only after Dan asks to remove one exact food entry. When needed, call listPendingFood first, pass its exact idempotencyKey, and set userConfirmed=true. Only pending entries can be cancelled; Apple Health records cannot be removed.

idempotencyKey.description: Exact key returned by logFood or listPendingFood.

userConfirmed.description: True only when Dan directly asks to cancel this exact pending entry.

200.description: Pending entry cancelled, or the same cancellation was safely retried.

422.description: Entry is not pending, was not identified exactly, or confirmation is missing.

503.description: Food queue or owner configuration is unavailable.

post.summary: Retry an exact uncertain food entry
post.description: Use only after Dan asks to retry one exact uncertain entry and Apple Health readback verifies its samples are absent. Pass the exact idempotencyKey and userConfirmed=true. This returns only that entry to the pending phone queue and refuses every other status so retries cannot happen automatically.

idempotencyKey.description: Exact key returned by nutrition history for the verified uncertain entry.

userConfirmed.description: True only after Dan asks to retry this exact uncertain entry and Apple Health readback shows its samples are absent.

200.description: The exact entry is pending for the phone again, or was already pending.

422.description: Entry is not uncertain, was not identified exactly, or confirmation is missing.

503.description: Food queue or owner configuration is unavailable.

post.description: Use only after Dan identifies one exact claimed entry, confirms the iPhone Shortcut is stopped, and verifies its samples are absent from Apple Health. All confirmation flags must be true. Returns only that claim to pending; never use while the Shortcut may still be running.

idempotencyKey.description: Exact key returned by nutrition history for the claimed entry.

userConfirmed.description: True only when Dan directly asks to release this exact claim.

shortcutStopped.description: True only after Dan confirms the iPhone Shortcut is no longer running.

appleHealthCheckedAbsent.description: True only after Apple Health readback confirms this entry's samples are absent.

200.description: The exact claimed entry is pending again, or was already pending.

422.description: Entry is not claimed, was not identified exactly, or required confirmations are missing.

503.description: Food queue or owner configuration is unavailable.

get.summary: Search or list saved food history
get.description: Search by remembered text, or list exact Sites meals for any date range. Use this for meal-level questions and to resolve an idempotencyKey before correction or deletion.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Meal, brand, ingredient, or remembered phrase. Omit when listing a date range.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive first date; provide with endDate when listing a period.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive final date; provide with startDate when listing a period.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Required maximum matching meals; normally use 10.

200.description: Matching previous meal logs, newest first.

idempotencyKey.description: Use this exact key when saving this meal as a favorite.

get.description: Search Dan's favorites by favorite name, alias, brand, meal name, or component. Always try this before prior history when he names a familiar meal or product.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Favorite name, alias, brand, meal, or ingredient. Omit to list recent favorites.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Required maximum matching favorites; normally use 10.

200.description: Matching saved favorites.

post.description: Use when Dan directly asks to save a favorite. Supply either an exact prior log key or a complete confirmed meal definition. Reusing a favorite name updates it.

favoriteName.description: Dan's preferred short name. If omitted in speech, use the meal name.

aliases.description: Useful alternate names or brands Dan mentioned, such as DM bar.

sourceIdempotencyKey.description: Exact key from logFood or searchFoodHistory. Use this or meal, never both.

meal.description: Complete confirmed meal definition when the favorite is not copied from a prior log.

userConfirmed.description: True only when Dan directly asks to save this favorite.

200.description: Favorite saved or updated.

404.description: The source meal was not found in retained history.

422.description: Favorite details or confirmation failed validation.

get.summary: Search or list saved meal plans
get.description: Returns reusable daily meal plans with breakfast, lunch, dinner, optional snacks, ingredient snapshots, complete nutrients, and server-calculated totals.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Plan, meal, favorite, slot, or ingredient. Omit to list recent plans.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Required maximum matching plans; normally use 10.

200.description: Matching meal plans.

post.summary: Build or update a meal plan
post.description: Use after resolving favorite IDs. Requires one breakfast, one lunch, one dinner, and any number of snacks. The server snapshots meals and totals all nutrients.

userConfirmed.description: True only when Dan directly asks to build or update this plan.

200.description: Meal plan saved or updated.

404.description: One or more favorite IDs do not exist.

422.description: Plan structure or confirmation failed validation.

get.summary: Get calorie balance for a period
get.description: Use for historical kcal intake, expenditure, deficit, surplus, or balance. Intake is Sites; expenditure is Apple Health active plus resting energy. If the range includes today, current.caloriesLeftKcal is the full-maintenance value, not the 15% target.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Inclusive first date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Inclusive final date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

200.description: Sites intake plus Apple Health expenditure, with completed-period totals and daily evidence.

netKcal.description: Dietary intake minus total expenditure. Negative means deficit; positive means surplus.

deficitKcal.description: Total expenditure minus dietary intake. Positive means deficit.

idempotencyKey.description: Exact retry, correction, deletion, and export key for this meal.

duplicate.description: True when this idempotency key already existed.

idempotencyKey.description: Pass this exact value to cancelFood after Dan identifies this entry.
Pass this exact value to cancelFood after Dan identifies this entry.
Use this exact key when saving this meal as a favorite.
Use this exact key when saving this meal as a favorite.

HealthSummaryResponse.description: Current normalized Apple Health and Sites nutrition data. For calories left today, read today.calorieGlance.caloriesLeftKcal.

netKcal.description: Dietary intake minus total expenditure. Negative means deficit; positive means surplus.

deficitKcal.description: Total expenditure minus dietary intake. Positive means deficit.

SiteDataResponse.description: Bounded read-only data returned from the same normalized Sites records used by Daily Overview.

x-source-evidence.evidence: Original Daily exported static contracts only; no handlers invoked, no credentials or records read.
